title: 第733章 连斩杀轻而易举第732章 皆出手各方手段
slug: 玄幻真龙为骨我刀问天下
content_zh:
“狂妄！”
“放肆！”
“你以为你是谁！？诗剑双绝嘛！”
“岂有此理！？在我万妖谷的地盘上，我妖族还能让人族给欺负了？”
半空中的八九尊四境大妖怒不可遏，周身散发出恐怖的妖气，不约而同的撞向陆去疾！
“诗剑双绝？稍逊风骚罢了。”
陆去疾轻笑一声，视周围蠢蠢欲动的数万妖卒于无物，径直往前跨出一步，旋即朗声一笑：“数风流人物，还看今朝！”
话音落下的一瞬间。
陆去疾将手中的两颗大妖头颅随意丢在脚边，双腿猛然一蹬。
“砰！”
陆去疾脚下的地面瞬间崩裂，巨大的反冲力使得他整个人陡然拔高，如一道白虹直直撞向不断下坠的八九尊四境大妖！
近身之际
陆去疾深吸一口清气，喝出一声：
“大日凌空式！”
他那两只蒲扇大小的拳头裹挟无可匹敌之势，没有丝毫花里胡哨，没有悍然递出！
轰隆——！
刹那间，金光炸裂，如大日破云而出！
刺目的光芒瞬间照亮了整座云深城，连那遮天蔽日的妖气都被硬生生撕开了一道口子。
距离陆去疾最近的两尊四境大妖连反应的机会都没有，便被那两股排山倒海的力量轰上九霄云外！
噼里啪啦……

两妖肉身在金光中迅速崩裂，最后化作漫天血雾与碎骨，纷纷扬扬洒落。
两尊四境大妖，一击毙命！
见此情形，剩余六七尊大妖瞳孔猛缩，心中顿时生出了一丝惧意：
“此人到底是谁！？为何有如此杀力？”
“这tm是四境！？”
呼哧～
剩余六七尊大妖深吸了一口气，勉强稳住了心神，心中不断告诉自己不能怕。
“不要怕！其他人都已经被拖住了，他只有一人，咱们有人数优势，以多战少，优势在我！”
“没错，一起上，宰了他！”
一尊生有双角的牛头大妖暴喝一声，率先冲出，两只铁拳裹挟滚滚妖风直砸向陆去疾面门！
另外五六尊大妖紧随其后，从四面八方杀向陆去疾！
刹那间，六七道刺鼻妖气交织成网，瞬间封死了陆去疾所有的退路！
妖风迎面而来，陆去疾不退不避，身子一沉，右拳紧握向天，左拳握紧立地，身后一轮大日虚影腾空而起！
就在牛头大妖铁拳即将落至陆去疾面门的一刹那，方圆百里，风云骤停，两轮大日缓缓上升，一时之间竟分不清那轮为真，那轮为假。
杀至陆去疾身前的六七尊四境大妖只觉一股恐怖的热浪袭来，而后便是眼前一白，不约而同的恍惚了一下。
就这一刻，陆去疾浑身气血沸腾，一拳轰出！
这一拳不偏不倚的轰在了牛头大妖的拳头上！
砰——！
两拳相交的刹那，牛头大妖整条右臂以一个诡异的角度弯折，骨茬从皮肉中刺出，鲜血飙射而出。
陆去疾余势不减，拳头上裹挟的恐怖杀力直接轰碎了牛头大妖的胸膛，拳锋从其后背透出，带出一蓬滚烫的血雨！

噗。
content_en:
"Arrogant!"
"Presumptuous!"
"Who do you think you are!? The master of poetry and swordsmanship!"
"Isn't this reasonable!? In my territory of the Ten Thousand Demons Valley, my demon clan can still be bullied by humans?"
The eight or nine great demons of the four realms in mid-air were furious, exuding a terrifying demonic aura, and all of them crashed into Lu Quji!
"The two masters of poetry and swordsmanship? Just a little less charming."
Lu Quji chuckled lightly, looking at the tens of thousands of demons around him who were ready to move, he took a step forward, and then laughed loudly: "If you count the famous people, let's look at the current situation!"
The moment the words fell.
Lu Quji casually threw the two big demon heads in his hands at his feet and kicked off his legs suddenly.
"Bang!"
The ground beneath Lu Quji's feet instantly cracked, and the huge recoil caused him to suddenly rise up, like a white rainbow, heading straight towards the falling Eighty-nine Great Demons of the Fourth Realm!
Up close
Lu Quji took a deep breath and shouted:
"Great Sun Volley Style!"
His two palm-leaf fan-sized fists contained unrivaled power, without any bells and whistles or blatant thrusts!
Boom——!
In an instant, golden light exploded, like the sun breaking through the clouds!
The dazzling light instantly illuminated the entire Yunshen City, and even the demonic energy that covered the sky was torn open.
The two Great Demons of the Fourth Realm closest to Lu Quji didn't even have a chance to react, and were blasted into the sky by those two overwhelming forces!
Crackling...
The fleshy bodies of the two demons quickly disintegrated in the golden light, and finally turned into blood mist and broken bones that scattered all over the sky.
Two great monsters from the four realms were killed in one blow!
Seeing this situation, the pupils of the remaining six or seven great demons shrank sharply, and a trace of fear suddenly arose in their hearts:
"Who is this person!? Why is he so murderous?"
"This is the Fourth Realm!?"
Huchi~
The remaining six or seven great demons took a deep breath and managed to calm down, constantly telling themselves not to be afraid.
"Don't be afraid! Everyone else has been held back. He is the only one. We have a numerical advantage. With more people fighting against fewer people, the advantage is mine!"
"That's right, come together and kill him!"
A big bull-headed demon with two horns roared loudly and rushed out first. Two iron fists carried the billowing demonic wind and smashed straight at Lu Quji's face door!
Five or six other great demons followed closely behind, attacking Lu Quji from all directions!
In an instant, six or seven strands of pungent demonic energy intertwined into a web, instantly blocking all Lu Quji's escape routes!
The evil wind came towards him, Lu Quji refused to retreat or dodge, his body sank, his right fist clenched towards the sky, his left fist clenched and he stood on the ground, a shadow of the big sun rose into the sky behind him!
Just when the bull-headed demon's iron fist was about to fall to Lu Quji's face gate, the wind and clouds suddenly stopped in a radius of a hundred miles, and the two suns rose slowly. For a moment, it was impossible to tell which one was real and which one was fake.
The six or seven great demons of the four realms who were fighting in front of Lu Quji felt a terrifying wave of heat coming over them, and then their eyes turned white and they all fell into a trance.
At this moment, Lu Quji's blood boiled all over and he punched out!
This punch hit the bull-headed demon's fist impartially!
Bang--!
The moment the two fists intersected, the entire right arm of the bull-headed demon was bent at a strange angle, bone stubble pierced from the flesh, and blood spurted out.
Lu Quji's momentum remained unabated, and the terrifying killing power contained in his fist directly shattered the chest of the bull-headed monster. The edge of the fist came out from its back, bringing out a shower of scalding blood!
